MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card and USB reader bundle felt relevant because the reader serves a practical computer connection need, much like my USB expansion card and Ethernet adapter.",
    "The cable recommendation captured some of my interest in useful accessories, although I would only choose one when I needed that particular connection."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices, smart plug and Fire TV Stick serve voice control, home automation or streaming needs that I have not shown an interest in.",
    "My old headset purchase does not establish that I use an iPhone or currently want wireless earbuds.",
    "The standalone memory cards and USB-C charging cables would require a specific storage or charging need that I do not currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seemed to treat buying computer accessories as an interest in electronics generally.",
    "Several choices assumed that a related accessory would be useful without evidence that I needed its particular function or had a compatible device."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My history points more strongly toward connecting devices and adding computer ports than toward entertainment or smart home products.",
    "My purchases are spaced far apart, and I rarely choose something unless it solves a concrete need; an older purchase does not mean I want another related product now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in practical computer accessories but stretched it into interests and current needs I have not expressed."
}
